name: threat-modeling
description: Use this skill when the user says 'threat model', 'STRIDE', 'security by design', 'data flow diagram', 'trust boundary', 'attack surface analysis'. Identifies and mitigates architectural security flaws during design using STRIDE and DFDs, before code is written. Do NOT use for: code-level vulnerability scanning (use security/sast-dast), attack-technique deep dives (use security/attack-patterns), or runtime detection (use security/detection-engineering).
